name: MonarchWorldMap
title: WorldMap
wrapsNative: Canvas with bundled simplified country outlines, SpatialTapGesture, inside MonarchChartFrame
summary: Values by country on a simplified world map: a choropleth in one data colour with a "Less … More" legend, or bubbles sized by value, with tiles for values that belong to no country and a data table.
whenToUse: For one metric by country where the geography matters: workspaces, revenue or traffic by country.
whenNotToUse: For exact comparison of a few countries, use MonarchBarList or MonarchBarChart. For places, routes or anything below country level, use MapKit's Map. For a matrix of two categories, use MonarchHeatmap.
api: init(_ title: String, data: [MonarchWorldMapDatum], description: String? = nil, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = .ready, variant: MonarchWorldMapVariant = .choropleth, color: MonarchChartColor = .data1, thresholds: [Double]? = nil, extras: [MonarchWorldMapExtra] = [], showsLegend: Bool = true, summary: String? = nil, emptyMessage: String? = nil, footer: String? = nil, labels: MonarchWorldMapLabels = MonarchWorldMapLabels(), countryName: ((String) -> String)? = nil, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchWorldMapDatum) -> Void)? = nil)
struct MonarchWorldMapDatum { init(_ country: String, value: Double, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail] = []) }
struct MonarchWorldMapDetail { init(_ label: String, value: String) }
struct MonarchWorldMapExtra: Identifiable { init(_ label: String, value: Double, key: String? = nil) }

struct MonarchWorldMapLabels { init(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), country: String? = nil, value: String? = nil, extras: String? = nil, less: String? = nil, more: String? = nil, rangeBelow: String? = nil, range: String? = nil, rangeAbove: String? = nil, unplaced: (@Sendable (String, String) -> String)? = nil, summary: (@Sendable (Int, String) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: title
options.description: The name of the chart, already localised.

options.name: data
options.description: One value per ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Codes are trimmed and upper-cased; a later entry for the same code wins; values that are not finite are left out.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title, such as the period.

options.name: status
options.description: Map, loading placeholder, empty state or error. A ready map without values or extras shows the empty state.

options.name: variant
options.description: Filled countries, or bubbles whose area grows with the value on a neutral map.

options.name: color
options.description: The data colour of the steps or bubbles.

options.name: thresholds
options.description: Three ascending values where levels 2, 3 and 4 start. Quarters of the largest value when nil.

options.name: extras
options.description: Values that belong to no country ("Global", "EU"), shown as tiles under the map and as table rows.

options.name: showsLegend
options.description: Shows the "Less … More" legend under a choropleth.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated summary that names the map for VoiceOver.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart, such as the source.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the chart frame's.

options.name: countryName
options.description: Names a country from its code. The default is Locale.localizedString(forRegionCode:) in the environment's locale, then the code.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a value. The default is a number in the environment's locale.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Runs with a country's datum when it is tapped or selected with VoiceOver, for drill-in.

states.name: ready
states.description: Countries with a value are filled in one of five steps of the data colour mixed into the muted background; the rest are muted. Countries too small for an outline get a dot.

states.name: bubble
states.description: Every country is muted; each country with a value has a circle in the data colour, largest drawn first so small ones stay on top.

states.name: inspected
states.description: After a tap or a VoiceOver swipe, the country is outlined in the default text colour and its name, value and details are written under the map.

states.name: unplaced codes
states.description: A muted note under the map: "Not on the map: XX (5)". The codes are still in the table and the summary.

states.name: loading, empty, error
states.description: The chart frame's placeholder, empty state and error with optional retry, keeping the height.

states.name: table
states.description: "View as table" replaces the map with one row per country and extra, a value column and a column per detail label.

appearance: Countries are filled with the theme's muted background and up to four mixes of the chosen data colour, separated by hairlines in the surface colour; the inspected country is outlined in the default text colour. Bubbles mix the data colour into the surface with a solid edge. Every colour comes from the theme, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow it.
platformNotes: Uses the same Natural Earth 1:110m outline, centroids, levels, bubble sizes, summary and table as the web's WorldMap, converted into the package. The web shows a floating tooltip on hover and steps through countries with the arrow keys; on iOS a tap inspects a country and writes its details under the map, and VoiceOver swipes up and down through the countries by value. The controlled activeCountry and onActiveCountryChange props are not offered. A tap that misses a small country finds the nearest country with a value within 22 points, because many countries are smaller than a 44-point target at phone width. The table toggle and the chart descriptor for Audio Graphs come from the chart frame's pieces. The map is never mirrored in right-to-left languages. Android uses the same name. Several closures are optional (countryName, formatValue, onRetry, onSelect). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is countryName.
accessibility: The map is one adjustable element named by the generated summary, for example "5 countries. Highest: United States 1,200, Germany 300, India 150.".
Swiping up and down moves through the countries with a value, largest first, and reads each as "Germany: 300, Users 90".
With onSelect the map has the button trait and a double tap selects the current country.
The map carries an accessibility chart descriptor with each country's value, for Audio Graphs.
The legend is one element read as its steps; the tiles under the map are a group named "Other values", each read as its label and value.
"View as table" gives every value in rows and columns; nothing is shown by colour alone.
edgeCases: Codes the map cannot draw (unknown or very small territories without a centroid) are listed under the map with their total.
Values of zero or less are drawn as the muted background, like countries without a value; the table still shows them.
With only extras and no countries, the tiles show without the map.
Ties are ordered by code, so the order is stable.
The outline is simplified for showing values; it is not for navigation and takes no position on disputed borders. Kosovo is XK; N. Cyprus is drawn as CY and Somaliland as SO.
Russia and Fiji cross the 180th meridian; the part past it is cut off at the map's right edge, as on the web.

examples.title: Choropleth with details and extras
examples.template:
MonarchWorldMap(
    {{title}},
    data: [
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.0.country}}, value: {{countries.0.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.0.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.1.country}}, value: {{countries.1.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.1.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.2.country}}, value: {{countries.2.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.2.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.3.country}}, value: {{countries.3.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.3.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.4.country}}, value: {{countries.4.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.4.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.5.country}}, value: {{countries.5.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.5.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.6.country}}, value: {{countries.6.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.6.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.7.country}}, value: {{countries.7.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.7.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.8.country}}, value: {{countries.8.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.8.users|raw}}")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.9.country}}, value: {{countries.9.value}}, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, value: "{{countries.9.users|raw}}")]),
    ],
    description: {{description}},
    extras: [MonarchWorldMapExtra({{extra.label}}, value: {{extra.value}}, key: {{extra.key}})]
)
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: {{locale}}))

        MonarchWorldMapDatum("DE", value: 380, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail("Users", value: "1020")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum("IN", value: 350, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail("Users", value: "1460")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum("BR", value: 210, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail("Users", value: "540")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum("FR", value: 190, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail("Users", value: "470")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum("JP", value: 120, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail("Users", value: "300")]),
        MonarchWorldMapDatum("AU", value: 95, details: [MonarchWorldMapDetail("Users", value: "210")]),

examples.title: Bubbles with drill-in
examples.code:
MonarchWorldMap(
    "Sessions",
    data: [MonarchWorldMapDatum("BR", value: 820), MonarchWorldMapDatum("AU", value: 310)],
    variant: .bubble,
    color: .data3,
    onSelect: { datum in selected = datum.country }
)
